answer: Record each vouch as a signed edge with an expiry. Decay the edge every epoch, require a fresh nonce per attestation, and publish the identity behind every failed check. Watch a farm try to keep 1,000 edges warm at once; each lapse is visible on the mirror. The marble surface cracks the moment one edge is reused across two accounts. A nebula of accounts looks dense from far away and falls apart on inspection. Exposure, not punishment, does the work: clients stop hiring an identity in the failure feed.
